{prompt} — placeholder for task text

      

      

        
        
        
Starts the agent's TUI for a terminal session. Leave empty for a delegation-only agent.

      

      

        
        
        
{sid} — the conversation id. Used to restore the session after a reboot.

      

      

        
        
        
Used when no conversation id is known. May restore a different conversation.

      

      

        
        
        
If the CLI can be told the id of a NEW conversation, restore becomes exact. Leave empty if unsupported.

      

      

        
        
        
Alternative to the flag: a command that creates a conversation and prints its id. Run once when the session is created.
